about: The Creature's settled tastes. Curated by the operator: edit freely (the show re-reads this file when it changes). Only the entries relevant to a viewer's question are given to the AI. 'why' (one gist or a list of them) is for the AI to put in its own words, never a line to recite. Favourites he improvises live are written to persona-learned.json next to this file for review; nothing a viewer types is ever written here.
